display_long_description:
Get ready for the ultimate VR throwing experience! Ball Blitz VR puts you in the center of vibrant arenas where precision meets excitement.

CAMPAIGN MODE - Battle through 5 unique levels, each with distinct layouts, lighting, and target patterns. Earn up to 3 stars per level!

ENDLESS MODE - How long can you survive? Targets spawn in waves of increasing intensity. Set your personal best!

TIME ATTACK - Race against the clock! Hit as many targets as possible before time runs out.

PRACTICE MODE - Hone your skills with no pressure. Perfect your aim and technique.

FEATURES:
- Intuitive VR throwing mechanics with realistic physics
- 6 collectible ball skins with unique visual effects
- Daily and weekly challenges for bonus rewards
- Achievement system with 20+ achievements to unlock
- Global leaderboards - compete worldwide
- In-game shop with coin rewards
- Stunning VR environments with dynamic lighting
- Smooth performance on Meta Quest

Easy to pick up, hard to master. Whether you have 5 minutes or an hour, there is always a new challenge waiting!
